HEADPHONES ON · FIRST TO SEVEN

Air Hockey Audio

Follow the puck by sound. Defend your goal by touch.

Ready to play.

How to play

  1. Use headphones. The puck moves between your left and right ears.
  2. Slide one finger left and right to move your paddle. A low hum marks its position.
  3. The puck becomes higher and louder as it approaches your goal.
  4. First to seven goals wins. Your score is spoken after each goal.

With VoiceOver: activate Start game, then turn VoiceOver off for direct touch play. Turn it back on to use the menu. You can use the side-button Accessibility Shortcut if configured.

Keyboard: Left and Right arrows move your paddle. Space pauses or resumes.

Install on iPhone

Open this page in Safari. Choose Share, then Add to Home Screen. Leave Open as Web App enabled if shown, then choose Add.

Browser test version · Audio and touch supported. Native vibration is unavailable on iPhone web apps.
